subtitle: Things nobody had on their bingo card
note: Anything that happens in 2026 counts, including what already has.

items.label: Brawl in congress
items.hint: Punches or shoving in any country's legislature, on camera

items.label: Social app banned
items.hint: A nationwide block of a major platform, even if it is lifted a week later

items.label: Beloved icon dies
items.hint: A national treasure. Someone your grandparents and your kids would both recognize

items.label: Hot mic scandal
items.hint: A head of state or government caught on a live microphone, audible and reported

items.label: Military coup
items.hint: The military takes power in any country, or tries to

items.label: Zoo animal escapes
items.hint: An escaped animal makes national news before it is caught

items.label: Airport drones
items.hint: Flights halted at an airport over drone sightings

items.label: Magnitude 8 quake
items.hint: Anywhere on Earth. The USGS number settles it

items.label: AI song hits No. 1
items.hint: An AI-made song reaches number one on any Billboard chart

items.label: Leader resigns
items.hint: A prime minister or president quits over a scandal

items.label: Giant sinkhole
items.hint: It takes a car, a house or a lane of road with it

items.label: Deepfake hoax
items.hint: A real news outlet runs a deepfake as genuine, then retracts

items.label: Landmark renamed
items.hint: A famous place gets an official new name, and people fight about it

items.label: FREE
items.hint: Free space

items.label: US goes to war
items.hint: Strikes on a country the US was not already fighting. Declared or not

items.label: National blackout
items.hint: A whole country loses power for hours, not minutes

items.label: Undersea cable cut
items.hint: It knocks a country or region offline

items.label: Volcanic ash cloud
items.hint: An eruption closes airspace across a region

items.label: Bridge collapses
items.hint: A highway or rail bridge, not a footbridge

items.label: Big new species
items.hint: A new species, formally described, bigger than a housecat

items.label: Extinct no more
items.hint: A company says it brought an extinct animal back. Their word is enough

items.label: World Cup shocker
items.hint: A top-10 team loses to one ranked outside the top 50

items.label: Band reunites
items.hint: A band that said it was over for good announces a tour or show

items.label: Celeb for president
items.hint: Any country. No political office before, and jokes do not count

items.label: UFO hearing
items.hint: Congress holds an official hearing on UAPs with sworn witnesses

items.label: Robot butler
items.hint: A paying customer gets a humanoid robot delivered to their home

items.label: Meteorite hits house
items.hint: A confirmed space rock, through a roof

items.label: Market drops 5%
items.hint: The S&P 500 or the Dow falls 5% in one trading day

items.label: WHO emergency
items.hint: The WHO declares a public health emergency of international concern

items.label: Alien life confirmed
items.hint: NASA or ESA says so, not a tabloid

items.label: New UN member
items.hint: The General Assembly admits a new country, and a new flag goes up outside

items.label: A monarch abdicates
items.hint: A reigning king or queen steps down

items.label: Tycoon rescued
items.hint: A billionaire needs rescuing from space or the bottom of the sea

items.label: Big Tech broken up
items.hint: A court orders a big tech company broken up

items.label: Celeb elected
items.hint: A celebrity with no political office before is elected head of state. Any country

items.label: Secession vote
items.hint: A US legislature or ballot votes to leave the union. It does not have to work

items.label: Country renamed
items.hint: A country changes its official name, recognized at the UN
